findings.title: q=+1 staging record conflicts with the current production-run provenance state
evidence: cite: Gate 11 / R-STA-002
source: JUDGMENT
finding_class: HARD
The submitted repair commit bc98bda31b8aaf4836e38b815ed66f90ef341fd3 is not an ancestor of the audited commit, so this snapshot retains the prior staging state.

ehpc/inputs_stage2/neb_q1_production/staging_manifest.json:3-4 declares submission_status BLOCKED_DO_NOT_SUBMIT and prohibits submission because the q1 source is absent; :20-24 says no real q1 staging/input existed, without a historical or superseded marker.

results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/PRODUCTION_NEB_STATUS.md:1-12 asserts BOTH LEGS CONVERGED, while :27-28 says q1/q1_initial_relaxed.extxyz and q1/q1_final_relaxed.extxyz close the input-source gap. The two current authorities assert incompatible q=+1 custody states.

reproduce: if git merge-base --is-ancestor bc98bda31b8aaf4836e38b815ed66f90ef341fd3 HEAD; then echo fix-is-ancestor; else echo fix-not-ancestor; fi; rg -n 'BLOCKED_DO_NOT_SUBMIT|does not describe a real staging|never backed by a real q1 input|BOTH LEGS CONVERGED|closes the F-003' ehpc/inputs_stage2/neb_q1_production/staging_manifest.json results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/PRODUCTION_NEB_STATUS.md; test -f results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/q1/q1_initial_relaxed.extxyz && shasum -a 256 results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/q1/q1_initial_relaxed.extxyz

proposed_check: C-STATE-007 — resolve every current production authority to its staging manifest and input paths; fail if an unmarked manifest says BLOCKED_DO_NOT_SUBMIT, never staged, or absent input while the authority says the run completed, or if a stated-absent path exists. Fixture: retain this manifest with the present production status.

findings.title: Canonical index omits the live XRD passivator-screen conclusions
evidence: cite: Gate 11 / R-NAV-001
source: JUDGMENT
finding_class: HARD
The submitted repair commit bc98bda31b8aaf4836e38b815ed66f90ef341fd3 is not an ancestor of the audited commit, so its proposed QX index row is absent from this snapshot.

RESULTS_INDEX.md:1-4 declares itself the one-row-per-question current-conclusion index. Its only XRD text at :101-102 is a generic independent-subproject pointer, with no XRD question, conclusion, authority, or raw-data locator.

xrd/PASSIVATOR_SCREEN.md:1-22 and :66-148 is a current six-film result with VALID/PROVISIONAL/NOT COMPARABLE dispositions, including P5 about 10% PbI2 (3.8x control) and P3 below detection. Neither RESULTS_INDEX.md nor xrd/README.md names PASSIVATOR_SCREEN.md.

reproduce: if git merge-base --is-ancestor bc98bda31b8aaf4836e38b815ed66f90ef341fd3 HEAD; then echo fix-is-ancestor; else echo fix-not-ancestor; fi; rg -n 'PASSIVATOR_SCREEN|P5|P3|Generations-0726|xrd/' RESULTS_INDEX.md xrd/README.md xrd/PASSIVATOR_SCREEN.md; sed -n '99,103p' RESULTS_INDEX.md

proposed_check: C-NAV-005 — require RESULTS_INDEX.md to contain one explicit current XRD/passivator row whenever an unmarked xrd/PASSIVATOR_SCREEN.md exists; the row must name that authority and its raw/results paths. Fixture: retain PASSIVATOR_SCREEN.md while stripping that row.

findings.title: Regression group 41 prints a false failure proposition as a passing result
evidence: cite: §10 / R-GRD-001
source: JUDGMENT
finding_class: HARD

AUDIT_CORRECTIONS_CYCLE1.md:98 explicitly marks the record HISTORICAL, and the group-41 predicate at scripts/20_test_checks.py:1152-1154 therefore passes. Its fixed message nevertheless says the count 'is not marked historical'.

scripts/20_test_checks.py:19-24 prints every successful expect() message after 'ok' without changing the failure-oriented message. Clean execution consequently emits 'ok ... count 36 != current 43 and is not marked historical', an assertion contradicted by the source record. The guard receipt is not truthfully derived from the condition it reports.
reproduce: python3 scripts/20_test_checks.py | sed -n '/\[41\]/,/\[42\]/p'; nl -ba AUDIT_CORRECTIONS_CYCLE1.md | sed -n '96,107p'; nl -ba scripts/20_test_checks.py | sed -n '19,25p;1129,1155p'

proposed_check: C-GUARD-003 — execute group 41 against a committed historical-count fixture and require its successful receipt to state that the mismatched count is historical/superseded; require an unmarked fixture to fail with the failure wording.

summary: BLOCK: F-022 and F-023 remain open because their submitted repair commit is not contained in the audited snapshot. F-024 is a non-blocking regression-receipt defect.

coverage.method: Read canonical navigation and current authorities first, then traced each open finding to its named manifests/status files, ran the Q3 derivation and full regression suite in a clean detached copy, and inspected the implicated test source and correction record.
not_examined: No exhaustive independent recomputation of every Objective 2 and XRD numeric result was performed; this cycle focused on the two still-open blockers, Q3 repair verification, and the regression receipt anomaly.
No remote scheduler, instrument, or uncommitted evidence was accessed.
